title: Mutex held across await
summary: Holding a Mutex, RwLock, or guard across an await point.
rationale: Locks held across suspension points can serialize work, create deadlocks, and amplify latency.

detection.notes: Detect lock guard lifetimes crossing .await in async functions.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Limit lock scope before await, clone small values, restructure state ownership, or use async-aware concurrency primitives carefully.
remediation.tradeoffs: Reducing lock scope may require rethinking shared mutable state.
